units.title: 鞋店里说清楚试穿需要

materials.title: Shoe Shop Needs 026
materials.text: A child visits a shoe shop with Mum. Choose the useful sentence for each need.

questions.prompt: The left shoe feels too small. You want to tell the helper. What do you say?
options: This left shoe is too small for me.
questions.explanation: A说明左鞋过小的具体问题；B窗净、C云数不反馈试穿。

questions.prompt: You want to know the price of the pair. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: B询整双价格；A椅龄、C河中物非购买价格。

questions.prompt: You want to try a larger pair before choosing. What do you say?
options: Give me every shoe in the shop.
May I try a larger pair?
questions.explanation: C请求试更大尺码；A要全店、B浸水不解决合脚选择。

questions.prompt: The helper asks if you need a bag, but Mum has one. What do you say?
options: No, thank you. We have a bag.
questions.explanation: A礼貌拒新袋并说明自带；B无脚不合情境；C拿走自袋反需求。

questions.prompt: You have chosen the comfortable pair and want to tell Mum. What do you say?
options: I want to stand on the shelf.
This pair feels good. May we choose it?
I will choose the pair that hurts.
questions.explanation: B舒适并请求选定；A架上站无关；C选伤脚与试穿目的相反。

units.title: 散步时把自己的需要说出来

materials.title: Family Walk Needs 026
materials.text: A child is walking with family. Choose the sentence that explains the need and asks for suitable help.

questions.prompt: Your legs are tired, and you need a short rest. What do you say?
options: May we sit down for a short rest?
questions.explanation: A请求短暂坐休对应腿累；B更快跑反需要；C搬树无关。

questions.prompt: The wind is cold, and you want your coat from Dad’s bag. What do you say?
options: Please give me more cold wind.
May I have my coat from your bag?
Is the moon made of paper?
questions.explanation: B取外套保暖；A更多冷风、C月材质不满足冷时需求。

questions.prompt: Sand blows into your eye. You want an adult’s help. What do you say?
options: I will hide it from everyone.
There is sand in my eye. Please help me.
questions.explanation: C清楚说明沙入眼并向成人求助；A隐瞒不求助；B鞋唱无关。

questions.prompt: You cannot hear Dad over a passing truck. What do you ask?
options: Could you say that again, please?
Could you make the truck bigger?
Could you turn the road blue?
questions.explanation: A噪声听漏后请求重说；B车更大、C路改色不澄清话语。

questions.prompt: You need a toilet and want to ask quietly. What do you say?
options: Can I throw my bag away?
Where is the nearest toilet, please?
questions.explanation: B问最近厕所位置；A丢包、C笔长与需求无关。

materials.title: Home Evening Ten Sentences 026
materials.text: Choose the correct word or reply for each complete evening-at-home situation.

questions.prompt: I ____ ready for dinner. My hands are clean.
questions.explanation: A I配am；B is单三、C are不配单数I。

questions.prompt: Mum is making soup. Dad and I are helping ____.
questions.explanation: B helping后宾格her指Mum；A she主格；C hers物主不作此人物宾语。

questions.prompt: There is one plate here and two ____ on the shelf.
questions.explanation: C two后plates标准复数；A单数；B拼写错。

questions.prompt: The spoon is near me. ____ spoon is for my soup.
questions.explanation: A近处单数this；B those、C these均复数不配spoon。

questions.prompt: Are the cups clean? Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: B cups复数they配are；A单数不符；C复数代词与is不搭。

questions.prompt: My brother is very hungry. He wants ____ bread.
questions.explanation: C bread不可数可用some；A a、B an不能直接限定本义bread。

questions.prompt: Please put the milk ____ the fridge to keep it cool.
questions.explanation: A在冰箱内保冷；B at旁点不表示放内；C背后不实现冰箱冷藏位置。

questions.prompt: We do not ____ television while eating at our table.
questions.explanation: B do not后watch原形；A单三、C分词不合。

questions.prompt: ____ do we eat dinner? At six thirty.
questions.explanation: C六点半回答When；A人物、B地点均不对时间答语。

questions.prompt: Let us ____ the dishes together after dinner.
questions.explanation: A let us后wash原形；B单三、C分词不合。

units.title: 等迟到的大巴时怎么商量

materials.title: Late Bus Wait Order 026
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The first line is fixed: 1. The class bus is late.
A. The teacher will meet the bus and call us.
B. No, let us wait inside the school gate.
C. Good. I will tell the others to wait here too.
D. Shall we wait by the road?
E. How will the driver find us inside?
Choose a position from 2 to 6 for each line.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: D第5步回答司机如何找到大家，教师会接车；A第2步问路边等；B第3步改校门内；C第4步才问如何找；E第6步向他人传达。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: B第3步No回应路边提议并改校门内；A第2步应先提路边；C第4步问司机；D第5步解释；E第6步通知他人。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: E第6步方案清楚后告知别人；A第2步提位置；B第3步替代；C第4步问接车；D第5步才解释。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: A第2步因车晚提出等路边；B第3步回应No校内；C第4步如何找；D第5步老师接；E第6步通知同学。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: C第4步接inside school gate追问司机如何找；A第2步尚未提校内；B第3步应先定校内；D第5步答；E第6步执行通知。

materials.title: Small Theatre Bank 026
materials.text:
Complete the whole passage from the bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. tickets B. behind C. quietly D. before E. return
We collect our ____1____ at the front desk. The helper checks them ____2____ we enter the hall. Performers wait ____3____ the curtain, not in front of it. Visitors speak ____4____ while music is playing. If we borrow a cushion, we ____5____ it to the basket after the show.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A tickets前台领票合义；B behind方位、C quietly副词、D before连接词、E return动词不是所领物。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D before进厅前验票；B behind不能接完整时间句；A tickets、C quietly、E return均不连接该句表先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B behind与not in front对应幕后的方位；A tickets物、C quietly方式、D before时间、E return动作不合幕后位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C quietly修饰speaks，音乐时低声；A tickets、B behind、D before、E return都不表示所需说话方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E return借垫演后归篮；A tickets、B behind、C quietly、D before均不作此处归还谓语。

materials.title: Printing Workshop Replies 026
materials.text:
Choose the reply that fits each question. Use each answer once.
A. The teacher who checks the tool list.
B. Because the ink has not dried yet.
C. On the shelf marked for finished work.
D. After the younger group has left.
E. Yes, if you keep it on the table.

questions.prompt: Who can sign our borrowed tools back in?
options: The teacher who checks the tool list.
Because the ink has not dried yet.
On the shelf marked for finished work.
After the younger group has left.
Yes, if you keep it on the table.
questions.explanation: A查工具表教师答Who；B墨未干原因、C架位、D时机、E许可不答负责人。

questions.prompt: Why must we not stack these prints yet?
options: The teacher who checks the tool list.
Because the ink has not dried yet.
On the shelf marked for finished work.
After the younger group has left.
Yes, if you keep it on the table.
questions.explanation: B墨未干解释不能叠；A人员、C成品架、D小组离开后、E桌上许可均非墨印状态原因。

questions.prompt: Where should the dry prints go?
options: The teacher who checks the tool list.
Because the ink has not dried yet.
On the shelf marked for finished work.
After the younger group has left.
Yes, if you keep it on the table.
questions.explanation: C成品标架答去处；A人、B原因、D时间、E许可不提供架位。

questions.prompt: When can we use the large printing space?
options: The teacher who checks the tool list.
Because the ink has not dried yet.
On the shelf marked for finished work.
After the younger group has left.
Yes, if you keep it on the table.
questions.explanation: D年幼组走后答时机；A人、B墨未干、C架、E物品留桌许可均不答场地轮次。

questions.prompt: May I use this stamp for a test?
options: The teacher who checks the tool list.
Because the ink has not dried yet.
On the shelf marked for finished work.
After the younger group has left.
Yes, if you keep it on the table.
questions.explanation: E可以但留桌上，答试章许可；A工具登记教师、B墨未干、C成品架、D组别时间均非该许可答句。

units.title: 合唱队里没有唱出的那一句

materials.title: Choir Breath Story 026
materials.text:
During a rehearsal, Amir stopped singing halfway through a long line. His friend Jo thought he had forgotten the words. She offered him a printed sheet, but he shook his head. He knew the words; he had run out of breath.
The choir leader divided the long line between two groups so nobody had to sing it all in one breath. Amir sang his part clearly. Jo realised that the same silence could have more than one explanation. After rehearsal, she asked whether he still wanted the word sheet for practice. He said yes, because it included the new ending added that morning. She had been wrong about his first difficulty, but the sheet could still be useful for a different reason. They marked the changed ending together.

questions.prompt: What does Jo first think Amir needs?
questions.explanation: B以为忘词而递词页；A/C/D非初猜。

questions.prompt: What actually stops Amir in the long line?
questions.explanation: C气息不够；A厌众、B烧纸、D已结束均不符。

questions.prompt: What change does the leader make?
options: Split the long line between two groups.
questions.explanation: A长句分两组唱；B赶出、C禁呼吸、D取消尾句均非做法。

questions.prompt: Why does Amir later accept the word sheet?
options: To prove Jo’s first guess was correct.
To hide it from the leader.
To practise an ending changed that morning.
questions.explanation: D含今早新结尾需练；A不证明初猜，B/C无据。

questions.prompt: What does Jo learn?
options: One visible result may have different causes.
Offering help can never be useful.
Every choir line must stay unchanged.
questions.explanation: B相同停唱可能不同原因，询问后理解；A唯一归因错误；C词页后来仍有用；D领唱已调整。

materials.title: School Shop Repair Return 026
materials.text: The uniform shop offered free button repairs for one week. Pupils left a shirt with a numbered slip attached. A matching slip stayed with the pupil. One shirt needed a torn seam repaired as well. The helper explained that the free offer covered buttons only. She did not promise a free seam repair. The pupil chose to collect the shirt after the button was fixed and discuss the seam with a parent. At collection, staff matched both numbers before returning the shirt. The shop later added "Buttons only" in larger writing so the offer’s limit was easier to see.

questions.prompt: The special free service covered every kind of clothing repair.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅纽扣，非全部；A扩大优惠范围。

questions.prompt: The shirt and pupil had matching numbered slips.
questions.explanation: A正确：一附衫一留本人号同；B否认识别方式。

questions.prompt: The helper clearly explained that seam repair was outside the free offer.
questions.explanation: A正确：buttons only非free seam；B否认边界说明。

questions.prompt: The pupil was forced to accept an extra paid repair immediately.
questions.explanation: B正确：选择修钮后取回与家长商量；A强迫即时付费无据。

questions.prompt: Larger wording was added to clarify the offer’s scope.
questions.explanation: A正确：Buttons only加大易见；B否认文字改进目的。

materials.title: Sports Report Word Forms 026
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last week, our team ____1____ (win) the relay by a small distance.
2. There are four ____2____ (person) in each relay team.
3. May ran ____3____ (fast) than she did in the first practice.
4. Look! The helpers are ____4____ (put) the equipment back in its boxes.
5. The captain thanked everyone ____5____ (warm; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) after the event.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use WIN.
questions.explanation: 接受won：Last week过去时，win不规则变won；win原形、winned错误、winning分词均不作所需过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use PERSON.
questions.explanation: 接受people或persons：four后需人的复数，people常用，persons在正式表述人数亦合法；person单数，peoples指各民族而非本句四名队员。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use FAST.
questions.explanation: 接受faster：than明确比较速度；fast原级、fastest最高级、fastly非标准所需形式均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use PUT.
questions.explanation: 接受putting：are构成进行时，put双写t加ing；put原形、puting拼错、puts单三均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from WARM.
questions.explanation: 接受warmly：本空明确要求WARM派生的常规-ly副词。列出的其他形态不满足本题-ly任务约束；这并不声称其在所有英语语境中不合法，也不因缺少明示比较就否定可能的隐含比较。未列形式仍进入复核。

units.title: 小组分工中的礼貌澄清

materials.title: Group Task Courtesy Functions 026
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each speaker’s purpose.

questions.prompt: A teammate assigns you a heavy box you cannot safely carry alone. You want a realistic alternative. What do you say?
options: I will pretend it is light.
Could someone share this lift, or may I take a lighter box?
You must carry every box forever.
questions.explanation: B说明需合搬或轻箱，具体调整任务；A假装轻不解决能力限制；C永久全推给人不合理。

questions.prompt: You are unsure whether a task is a suggestion or a confirmed plan. What should you ask?
options: Has this been agreed, or is it still a suggestion?
questions.explanation: C澄清决定状态；A包美、B桌腿无关分工承诺。

questions.prompt: You need to leave early and want to hand your unfinished task over clearly. What do you say?
options: I have checked these three items; could you continue with the rest?
Everything is done even though it is not.
questions.explanation: A说明已核三项和余项交接；B虚报完工；C让猜无清楚边界。

questions.prompt: You disagree with an idea and want to give a useful reason. What should you say?
options: That is stupid, and I will not explain.
I am concerned that this table will block the exit. Could we move it?
questions.explanation: B具体出口受堵问题加替代建议；A侮辱无理由；C抹差异不说明顾虑。

questions.prompt: A helper checks your work and finds an error. You want to acknowledge and correct it. What do you say?
options: The first answer must stay because I wrote it.
Please hide the error from the group.
Thank you for checking. I will correct that entry.
questions.explanation: C感谢核查并更正；A固守错、B藏错不达合作修正。
